title: Act: Add gold button variant, header suggest button and App wiring
summary: Add the gold variant, render it in the header, and remove the old App button.
description: Wire onSuggest and suggestRef through HeaderOverlay from App.
acceptance_criteria: Header shows the gold suggest button with the accessible name Suggest What Happens Next.
App has no other suggest button.
technical_constraints: Palette tokens only; Tailwind and React stay.

steps.action: Extend ButtonVariant to 'default' | 'ghost' | 'frame' | 'gold'. Add to variantClasses the entry gold: 'sf-btn sf-btn-gold inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-pixel text-sf-sm'. In Button, treat variant 'gold' like 'frame' when building frameProps (condition variant === 'frame' || variant === 'gold').
steps.code: gold: 'sf-btn sf-btn-gold inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-pixel text-sf-sm'
steps.expected: <Button variant="gold"> renders with class sf-btn-gold and data-state.

steps.action: Append .sf-btn-gold { background: var(--sf-color-brass-5); color: var(--sf-color-wood-1); text-transform: uppercase; }
steps.expected: Gold styling uses brass and wood tokens.

steps.action: Import type Ref from react. Add props onSuggest?: () => void and suggestRef?: Ref<HTMLButtonElement>. Before the sound Button render <Button type="button" variant="gold" ref={suggestRef} aria-label="Suggest What Happens Next" onClick={onSuggest}>+ SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT</Button>.
steps.expected: Header shows the gold button and calls onSuggest on click.

steps.action: Pass onSuggest={() => setSheetOpen(true)} and suggestRef={triggerRef} to <HeaderOverlay>. Delete the <Button ...>Suggest What Happens Next</Button> element in the scene fragment and the now-unused Button import.
steps.expected: Only the header holds the suggest button; ContributionSheet still receives returnFocusRef={triggerRef}.
